name: stat-card
description: A collapsible card holding a label/value table. The repeating summary block on coin_home, address, token, market and dispenser.

id.description: The collapse target id; also names the header element (<id>-header).

icon.description: Font Awesome class for the title glyph.

open.description: Whether the card starts expanded. Restored per viewer from the collapse memory when present.

rows.description: Ordered { label, cell } rows. Order and visibility are the theme's; the cell name is the identity a render function writes into.
